name: Hibiscus
hook: Buds dropping? Your hibiscus hates being moved.

steps.title: 4–5+ hours of direct sun
steps.tip: A south or west window or sunny balcony is best: more sun, more flowers. Shade it from hot afternoon sun.

steps.title: Evenly moist, never soggy
steps.tip: Water until it drains, empty the saucer, and never let it wilt. In winter, let the top dry out first.

steps.title: Keep it warm and still
steps.tip: Buds need 18–24°C. Keep it away from drafts and radiators. Bring it in before nights drop below 12°C.

steps.title: Feed at half strength
steps.tip: Use balanced fertilizer at half strength every 2–4 weeks in spring and summer, and little or none in winter.

steps.title: Cut back in late winter
steps.tip: Cut it back by up to half in February–March. Flowers form on new growth, so later pruning delays blooms.

steps.title: Rinse off aphids and mites
steps.tip: Check leaf undersides for aphids, spider mites and whitefly. Rinse often; use insecticidal soap if needed.

outro: Steady sun, steady water and no moving it: blooms all summer.

sources.title: NC State Plant Toolbox: Hibiscus rosa-sinensis
